requirement.normalizedRequirement: Set design_line_load_MN_m = max(p_MPa*h_m, 0.15) and outside_ice_belt_factor = 1 - h_s_m/l_s_m. Compute Z_cm3 = 0.80*1.8*design_line_load_MN_m*l_m^2/(m*sigma_y_N_mm2)*outside_ice_belt_factor*10^6 and A_cm2 = sqrt(3)*0.80*1.8*1.2*design_line_load_MN_m*l_m/(2*sigma_y_N_mm2)*outside_ice_belt_factor*10^4.
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The section modulus of a stringer situated outside the ice belt but supporting ice-strengthened frames shall be calculated using Z = f_9*f_10*p*h*l^2/(m*sigma_y)*(1 - h_s/l_s)*10^6 [cm^3] (4.13), and the effective shear area shall be A = sqrt(3)*f_9*f_10*f_11*p*h*l/(2*sigma_y)*(1 - h_s/l_s)*10^4 [cm^2] (4.14). Use p from 4.2.2, h from 4.2.1, p*h = 0.15 MN/m when the calculated product is less than 0.15 MN/m, l as stringer span, m from 4.4.3, l_s as the distance to the adjacent ice stringer, h_s as the distance to the ice belt, f_9 = 0.80, f_10 = 1.8, f_11 = 1.2, and sigma_y from 4.3.2.
